concepts.name: glob-gun
concepts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a polished square weapon concept sheet for an existing low-poly voxel FPS. Match the visual language of the silver/charcoal/orange weapon concept sheet and in-game models shown in the conversation: chunky beveled light silver armor shells, charcoal recessed mechanisms and grips, thin crisp dark edge lines, subtle flat-faceted shading, readable solid-color luminous inserts. Practical silhouettes suitable for procedural meshes, layered components, restrained detail, no excessive greebles. Muted deep navy background. Large three-quarter hero rendering, smaller consistent side view, and a clearly separated action inset explaining gameplay. Clean large white sans-serif headings and very short readable labels. Generous spacing. The image must show the weapon AND visually explain its specified role. This is a new concept, not an edit or a copy of the pictured shotgun. Title exactly 'GLOB GUN'. A compact full-auto sibling of the default silver and cyan claw pistol: short squat beveled silver receiver, black pistol grip, two short framing prongs around a broad recessed nozzle, a protected visible cartridge of viscous luminous acid-green gel, segmented green pressure/status bars. Distinctive sticky glob appearance, but the firearm casing remains angular and mechanical. Projectiles are small green gelatinous globs, not giant splashes or a flamethrower. Large hero plus side view, a close-up of one glowing glob stuck to a robot enemy's shoulder, and a small action inset showing a short stream of globs hitting a robot. Exact concise text: 'FULL AUTO', 'LOWER DAMAGE THAN DEFAULT', 'BLOCKS MATTER RESTORATION FOR 5s', 'GLOBS THEN DISAPPEAR'. A tiny 5-second timer beside attached globs and a crossed-out Matter restoration symbol communicate the debuff. Do not imply slowing, stun, freezing, healing theft, damage over time, or permanent goo. Purpose is sustained pressure and blocking Matter recovery; no numerical damage tuning.

concepts.name: glock-pistol
concepts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a square game weapon concept sheet on the same muted deep navy background with clean white sans-serif headings as the silver low-poly sci-fi weapon sheets shown in this conversation. This weapon is deliberately the exception to their art style: an ordinary realistic Glock-pattern semiautomatic pistol, recognizable Glock silhouette and proportions. Title exactly 'REGULAR GUN'. The weapon itself should be a high-quality realistically shaded game asset: matte black polymer frame with subtle molded stipple, dark blued steel squared slide with realistic roughness and restrained metallic highlights, rear slide serrations, ordinary squared trigger guard and iron sights. No energy inserts, no futuristic armor, no luminous seams, no chrome, no ornate embellishments, no attachments. Large three-quarter studio hero view, smaller accurate matching side profile, and a material detail inset contrasting polymer grip and metal slide. A small gameplay inset shows the same pistol firing a conventional single shot with a short muzzle flash at a stylized robot silhouette with a low Matter indicator; no gore. Exact brief labels: 'GLOCK PISTOL', 'LOW MATTER DAMAGE', 'CAN KILL', 'REALISTIC METAL + POLYMER'. This is visual art direction for a fictional game, not a technical firearms schematic: no exploded internals, no dimensions or assembly steps.
